entry.title: grok-imagine-image-quality retired
entry.content: Requests to grok-imagine-image-quality and grok-imagine-image-pro are now served by grok-imagine-image-2.0-low : grok-imagine-image-2.0 with quality set to low , at a lower per-image price. No request changes are needed. usage.cost in usd ticks on each response reflects the lower price, and gRPC responses (xAI SDK) report grok-imagine-image-2.0-low as the model . See the migration guide.

entry.title: Conversion API for App Events
entry.content: Advertisers can send app installs and in-app events to X without a mobile measurement partner. Create the app event in Events Manager, generate an access token, and post events to POST /12/accounts/:account_id/measurement/app_conversions .

entry.title: Free credit incentives for pay-per-use accounts
entry.content: Pay-per-use accounts can now earn free X API credits two ways: a one-time $20 when an account saves its first eligible payment card, and a one-time match of the first successful auto-recharge, up to $50 . A new account that earns both receives $70 in free credits. Credits are applied automatically with no code or form, appear in the Developer Console within about a minute, are spent before purchased credits, and expire 3 months after they are granted. The incentives are rolling out now.

entry.title: Custom moderation controls
entry.content: You can now set content guidelines on text API requests. Add a guidelines array to a Chat Completions or Responses API request to set how Grok handles content in the nsfw , violence , and profanity categories. Grok follows the guidelines as it writes its response. See Custom Moderation Controls.

entry.title: Grok Voice 2.0 deprecation

entry.title: Grok Voice 3.0 is available
entry.content: grok-voice-3.0 is now available with Speech to Speech, at the same price as Grok Voice 2.0. grok-voice-latest now points to grok-voice-3.0 , so sessions that use the alias are upgraded automatically. The API is unchanged. To get started, see the Speech to Speech docs.

entry.title: Real-time reply moderation guide now uses Grok
entry.content: We rewrote the Manage replies in real time integration guide. It now receives replies through the X Activity API post.reply.create event, classifies each reply with Grok through the xAI API using structured outputs, and hides high-confidence violations with the Hide Replies endpoint. The previous version relied on the deprecated Perspective API and the Account Activity API.

entry.title: Migrate OAuth 1.0a user tokens to OAuth 2.0 with token exchange
entry.content: Apps with existing OAuth 1.0a users can now exchange each user’s stored OAuth 1.0a access token and secret for an OAuth 2.0 access token and refresh token, with no consent screen or re-authorization. Send grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange to POST /2/oauth2/token ; the granted scopes are derived from the permissions the user originally authorized, and offline.access is always included.
